capabilities: Check in habits from the right sidebar
Track streaks and yearly heatmaps in a main view
Support single, goal and timer check-in modes
Color heatmap days by custom intensity levels
extras: Check-in records are stored as per-day JSON files under records/ to limit sync conflicts; upgrading to 0.1.7 creates a one-time snapshot in backups/pre-activity-v2/ and does not convert existing modes, goals or units automatically.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record daily habit check-ins and see streaks or a year-at-a-glance heatmap.

relations.evidence: After a check-in, the date is automatically marked with a dot in the Calendar plugin

summary: Sidebar habit tracker with single, goal and timer check-in modes, streak statistics, yearly heatmaps and heatmap blocks embeddable in notes.
